sources.location: ~50 RAW headers sampled across the three file families (instrument + method name)

claims.value: 30 healthy men × time points A (baseline), B (week 3 after degarelix), C (week 5, after testosterone undecanoate)
claims.evidence: RAW names <A|B|C>-<subject>-…_DTPI_<n> and <A|B|C><subject>_…_tp_<n>; the randomised sample number n is identical in the DDA and MRM names of the same subject/time point

claims.value: 75 men investigated for infertility, serum, MRM only
DTPI = Q Exactive Plus DDA; tp and Hypo_dep = TSQ Quantiva SRM
claims.evidence: RAW headers (DDAHV18_Top20 method vs TP_pool_sched MRM methods)

claims.value: CAM C fixed; Ox M variable; 10 ppm / 0.02 Da (DDA rows only)

limitations: Testosterone group (low / borderline / normal) of each infertile patient is not deposited — phenotype states this.
Per-subject ages not available (cohort ranges only).
Heavy isotope-labelled reference peptides spiked into MRM samples are not encoded (no spiked-compound column).
Time point C subjects had also received degarelix at week 0; compound column lists only the most recent drug.
Only ~50 of 770 RAW headers were read; instrument per file family is assumed uniform.
